1: "For kings" - they were accustomed to date their contracts by the year of the king from the year of the king's ascension as is said in Tractate Gittin (80a) to have a peaceful relationship with the kingdom. The Sages established the first of Nissan as the start of his year. Even if he ascended to the throne in Shevat or in Adar his [first] year ends when Nissan comes and they start to count the 2nd year.
And for the festivals - This is explained in the Gemara (4a)
